description: Write a pandas ETL script for saas_metrics that computes daily active users (DAU) and rolling 7-day active users (WAU) for the reporting range 2025-01-01 to 2025-01-04 inclusive. The script should: (1) derive activity_date from event_ts in UTC, (2) compute DAU as the number of distinct users per day, (3) compute WAU for each day as the number of distinct users active in the 7-day window ending on that day (inclusive), (4) emit one row for every date in the reporting range, including days with no events.
edge_cases: Distinct counts are not additive: a rolling sum of DAU gives WAU = 2, 3, 4, 4 instead of 2, 2, 3, 3
u1 has two events on 2025-01-02 and counts once
2025-01-04 has no events and must still appear with dau 0 and wau 3
With real data preceding the reporting range, the 6 days before the first report date must be read to compute its WAU
common_failure_modes: FM3: Rolling sum of daily distinct counts used as the weekly distinct count
FM3: Days without events missing from the output, breaking downstream time series
FM2: Window off by one day (8-day or 6-day window)
